title: Design System: Centro Educativo Villa de Ángeles

brand.purpose: The school's name only: home hero headline, nav wordmark, footer name. Never translated.

display.purpose: Largest content statements: level age ranges, marquee value names, inner page-intro titles.

headline.purpose: Section headings, always paired with the hand-drawn amber underline.

statement.purpose: The one scroll-lit paragraph per page (the mission on home).

title.purpose: Value-note titles, level-name chips, service strip labels.

lead.purpose: Intro paragraphs under a hero or page intro, 44ch to 58ch.

hand.purpose: One short handwritten aside per section, rotated -2° to -3°, in amber ink.

label.purpose: Nav links, field labels, footer links, button labels.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Resting content sheets, value notes, service strips, nav pill, marquee band, photo-stack controls.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Higher objects: level covers, requirements clipboard, Características notebook, WhatsApp button, exam timer.

shadows.name: polaroid
shadows.purpose: White-framed photos in the hero stack.

shadows.name: sticker
shadows.purpose: Filter (not box-shadow) on every die-cut sticker so the silhouette casts the shade.

shadows.name: focus-outline
shadows.purpose: Global keyboard focus; switches to sunflower amber inside crest regions.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Sunflower glow around a focused form field.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for every arrival, state change, and draw-in; Tailwind's default timing function.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Page-transition curtain and mobile menu close.

motion.name: duration-default
motion.purpose: Default transition duration for color and small state changes.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active state on every button and disc control; the touch substitute for hover.

motion.name: button-fill
motion.value: clip-path circle 0% to 150% from pointer entry; 480ms in, 260ms out, ease-out
motion.purpose: Pill hover flood (fine pointers only) and keyboard focus fill.

motion.name: arrival
motion.value: translateY 12px to 40px to 0, 550ms to 800ms ease-out, from a visible default
motion.purpose: Hero, page intro, and scroll reveals. No opacity-0 start for in-flow content.

motion.name: underline-draw
motion.value: pathLength 0 to 1, 700ms ease-out, 150ms delay, once in view
motion.purpose: Hand-drawn amber underline under section headings and page-intro titles.

motion.name: marker-swipe
motion.value: clip-path inset reveal left to right, 680ms ease-out, 420ms delay

motion.name: check-draw
motion.purpose: Checkmarks on the requirements notebook when it scrolls into view.

motion.name: sticker-bob
motion.value: 6s ease-in-out infinite, translate 0 -8px and rotate 4deg at midpoint; paused offscreen

motion.name: spring-magnetic
motion.purpose: Magnetic primary hero button, mouse only.

motion.name: spring-tilt
motion.value: stiffness 160, damping 18, mass 0.5; up to 7deg X and 9deg Y
motion.purpose: Photo stack tilt toward the pointer.

motion.name: spring-settle
motion.purpose: Photo stack reordering after a flick or tap.

motion.name: spring-sticker
motion.value: spring, duration 0.45s, bounce 0.3; drag bounce stiffness 260, damping 14
motion.purpose: Draggable sticker hover, grab, and snap-back.

motion.name: nav-highlight
motion.purpose: Active-page amber pill sliding between nav links.

motion.name: menu-wipe
motion.value: clip-path circle from the menu button, 550ms ease-out open, 300ms ease-in-out close; links stagger 50ms

motion.name: view-transition
motion.value: old page 320ms ease-in-out lift and fade; new page 560ms ease-in-out wipe up after 140ms, over a crest curtain with the crest logo
motion.purpose: Route changes via document.startViewTransition with flushSync.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: MotionConfig reducedMotion=user; view transition becomes a 160ms fade; per-component static fallbacks
motion.purpose: Photo stack becomes a grid, scroll-lit text becomes plain, marquee stops, stickers stop dragging and drifting.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sunflower pill for every forward action; floods crest from the pointer's entry point on fine-pointer hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 16px/1.5 "Source Sans 3 Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), color 240ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--sun, #f6b42c); color: var(--crest-deep, #1c1f5e); } .ds-btn-fill { position: absolute; inset: -2px; z-index: -1; background: var(--crest, #2b2f8f); clip-path: circle(0% at 50% 50%); transition: clip-path 260ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); pointer-events: none; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-btn-primary:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-fill { clip-path: circle(150% at 50% 50%); transition-duration: 480ms; } } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { color: #fff; outline: 3px solid var(--crest, #2b2f8f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible .ds-btn-fill { clip-path: circle(150% at 50% 50%); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.css: .ds-on-crest { display: inline-block; padding: 24px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--crest, #2b2f8f); } .ds-btn-l { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; background: var(--sheet, #fdfdff); border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--crest, #2b2f8f); font: 600 16px/1.5 "Source Sans 3 Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), color 240ms ease; } .ds-btn-l-fill { position: absolute; inset: -2px; z-index: -1; background: var(--sun, #f6b42c); clip-path: circle(0% at 50% 50%); transition: clip-path 260ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); pointer-events: none; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-btn-l:hover { color: var(--crest-deep, #1c1f5e); } .ds-btn-l:hover .ds-btn-l-fill { clip-path: circle(150% at 50% 50%); transition-duration: 480ms; } } .ds-btn-l:focus-visible { color: var(--crest-deep, #1c1f5e); outline: 3px solid var(--sun, #f6b42c); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-l:focus-visible .ds-btn-l-fill { clip-path: circle(150% at 50% 50%); } .ds-btn-l:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: White field with a faint crest stroke; focus turns the stroke crest and adds a sunflower glow.
components.css: .ds-field-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: 360px; } .ds-field-label { font: 600 14px/1.25 "Source Sans 3 Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--crest, #2b2f8f); } .ds-field-req { color: #dc2626; } .ds-field { margin-top: 6px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(43, 47, 143, 0.22); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--ink, #1b1d3a); font: 400 15px/1.4 "Source Sans 3 Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--crest, #2b2f8f); outline: none; transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #5b5e8f; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: rgba(43, 47, 143, 0.45); } .ds-field:focus { border-color: var(--crest, #2b2f8f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(246, 180, 44, 0.55); } .ds-field[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #c0392b; } .ds-field:disabled { background: #eceef5; color: #5b5e8f; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.css: .ds-sticker-stage { display: inline-flex; padding: 32px; background: var(--paper, #f4f6fa); } .ds-sticker { display: inline-flex; rotate: -12deg; filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 12px rgba(28, 31, 94, 0.28)); cursor: grab; transition: scale 450ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), rotate 450ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-sticker:hover { scale: 1.06; rotate: -18deg; } } .ds-sticker:active { cursor: grabbing; scale: 1.12; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-sticker svg { animation: ds-bob 6s ease-in-out infinite; } } @keyframes ds-bob { 50% { translate: 0 -8px; rotate: 4deg; } }

narrative.overview:
The site is a Dominican school notebook come alive. The crest's royal blue fills whole pages the way a notebook cover does; sunflower amber is the single action color, the highlighter swiped across one word and the pill a parent taps to start admission. Everything sits on a cool paper ground with a fine grain, and the school's own material carries the trust: real photographs of its children and classrooms, the crest, the mission, the seven values, the two levels, the requirements list. Die-cut stickers (gold star, pencil, crown, block, paper plane, laurel, wing, clip) are the child's energy, orbiting content rather than replacing it.

Density is generous and rhythmic: wide sections on a 72rem measure, big display type, then a calm reading line. The page alternates between paper stretches and crest-blue bands with 2rem to 3rem rounded edges, so scrolling feels like turning between notebook pages and their covers. A handwritten margin voice in Shantell Sans adds one short aside where a teacher would write it. Motion is ease-out and arrives from an already-visible default: content nudges into place, it never fades up from nothing. Springs are reserved for objects a hand can grab (the polaroid photo stack, draggable stickers, the magnetic primary button). One statement per page lights up word by word on scroll, and one marquee band runs the school's values.

The world refuses the category default for school sites: a full-bleed photo slideshow, generic program cards, a centered crest, and invented proof. There are no testimonials, counters, rankings, or badges, because none exist. Spanish is the primary language and English is equal; every layout has to hold both string lengths.
keyCharacteristics: Crest royal blue as whole regions (page intros, vision band, level cover, clipboard, footer, mobile menu), never as scattered tints.
Sunflower amber as the only action color, plus a few committed amber regions (values marquee band, value notes, the Primario level cover).
Cool paper ground with a mirror-tiled grain texture; content sheets in near-white with soft crest-tinted shadows.
Die-cut raster stickers with a white border and a crest drop shadow; palm green and coral live only inside them.
Highlighter swipe on one word and hand-drawn amber underlines under section headings.
Pill controls, 16px cards, 2rem to 3rem rounded bands.
Ease-out arrivals from a visible default; springs only for grabbable objects; hover only on fine pointers; full reduced-motion fallbacks.
Page changes pass behind a crest-blue curtain carrying the crest.

rules.name: The One Action Color Rule
rules.body: Every tappable pill that moves a parent forward is sunflower amber, or an outline or sheet pill that fills with crest on hover. No second action color exists.

rules.name: The Whole Region Rule
rules.body: Crest blue is committed as full regions with rounded band edges, not sprinkled as tinted boxes. A section is either paper or crest.

rules.name: The Sticker Accent Rule
rules.body: Palm green and coral appear only inside sticker art. The WhatsApp button is the single exception for palm, because parents recognize that green as the channel.

rules.name: The One Blackletter Rule
rules.body: Pirata One sets the school's name and nothing else. Headings, titles, and numbers never borrow it.

rules.name: The Margin Voice Rule
rules.body: Shantell Sans is a handwritten aside: one short line, slightly rotated, in amber ink or crest. It never sets body copy, buttons, labels, or headings.

rules.name: The Crest-Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is soft, pulled below the object by a negative spread, and tinted crest night. No neutral black shadows, no hard offsets.

rules.name: The 16px Cap Rule
rules.body: No card, sheet, or photo panel rounds past 16px. Only full-width bands (2rem to 3rem) and pills go further.

rules.name: The Visible Default Rule
rules.body: In-flow content is readable before any animation runs. Arrivals are small upward nudges (12px to 40px) with ease-out; nothing in the page flow starts at zero opacity.

rules.name: The Springs Are For Hands Rule
rules.body: Spring physics belong only to things a hand can grab: the photo stack, draggable stickers, and the magnetic primary button. Everything else moves on ease-out curves.

rules.name: The Fine Pointer Rule
rules.body: Hover effects apply only when the device can hover with a fine pointer. Touch users get press feedback (scale 0.97) instead.

dos: Do fill whole regions with crest royal blue and round only the edge that meets paper (2rem on phones, 3rem from tablet up).
Do make every forward action a sunflower amber pill, or an outline or sheet pill that floods crest on hover.
Do use the school's own photographs and words: its photos, crest, mission, values, levels, and requirements.
Do give each section heading the hand-drawn amber underline, and give at most one word per page the highlighter swipe.
Do set handwritten asides in Shantell Sans, one short line, rotated -2° to -3°, in amber ink.
Do tint every shadow with crest night and keep it soft with a negative spread.
Do animate with ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) from a visible default, and provide a static fallback for every scroll-, drag-, or loop-driven effect under reduced motion.
Do route internal links through the transition link so page changes pass behind the crest curtain.
Do check every layout with both Spanish and English strings; Spanish is primary and usually longer.
donts: Don't use palm green or coral in UI fills, borders, or text; they belong to stickers, except palm on the WhatsApp button.
Don't set sunflower amber as text on paper; use amber ink.
Don't round cards, sheets, or photo panels past 16px.
Don't fade in-flow content up from zero opacity.
Don't put springs on anything that cannot be grabbed.
Don't apply hover effects outside a hover-capable, fine-pointer device.
Don't use Pirata One for anything but the school's name.
Don't add more than one scroll-lit statement or more than one marquee to a page.
Don't add testimonials, enrollment counts, rankings, accreditation badges, or stock photography; the school has none of those claims.
